# Pixel IMS 5G 2.2.10

Adds KernelSU late-load (temporary root) support to the regional modem patch. Version code 42 updates existing public GitHub installations in place.

- **Temporary root works with the modem patch:** With KernelSU late-load, the patch used to stop with *late-load unsupported* ([#23](https://github.com/barrylk/Pixel-IMS-5G/issues/23)). It now runs the same verified steps as a normal boot: checksum checks, SELinux label copy, read-only bind of `cfg.db` only, and a restore to stock if anything fails.
- **After a late-load:** The modem reads its database at boot, before temporary root applies the patch. The app says so and asks you to toggle airplane mode or reinsert the SIM before judging the result. Temporary root has to be reapplied after every reboot. Whether the modem fully picks up the patch without a reboot is not yet confirmed; reports are welcome on #23.
- **Corrected capability log wording:** In the radio log summary, a modem capability log without band combinations is now described as a feature/bandwidth table. Earlier versions wrongly called it an empty capability and a key lead.

## Known limitation: Pixel 10 Pro XL 5G

Some Pixel 10 Pro XL users stay on LTE where other phones get n78 5G. **2.2.10 does not fix this.** Recent captures at a strong LTE anchor show the network offering EN-DC while the phone reports no 5G measurements, so the cause is still being investigated.

## Updating

Existing public GitHub builds update in place with `Pixel-IMS-5G-v2.2.10.apk`, signed with the established public release identity.
